card.name: Words just before a bracketed insertion
card.fires_on: Ordinary words in quoted or old-style prose (history, law, essays, poetry) where a bracket or citation marker could come next. It also fires on a colon in an index listing.

modes.label: Quoted historical prose
modes.description: A linking word or adjective inside a quotation from an old essay, legal text or poem, just before an editor's bracket could appear.
modes.example: The passing of the sweetest soul That ever look'd with<< human>> eyes.

modes.label: Colon in a listing
modes.description: A colon after a term in a printed list of entries, where a bracketed list may follow.

modes.label: Titles and phrases
modes.description: A word inside a book title or fixed phrase from scholarly writing.
modes.example: such as An Introduction to the Principles of Morals<< and>> Legislation (1892)

card.writes: It promotes opening square brackets and suppresses quote-mark openings and words like world and client.
card.plain: It fires on a word in old-style quoted prose where a square bracket might be inserted next.
